findings.note: SportsLine's simulation model picks Over 40. It projects 48 combined points and says the Over has hit in three of the last four head-to-head meetings and in each of Jacksonville's last two games.

Third-string QB Joe Fagnano is set to start with Lamar Jackson headed to IR and Tyler Huntley hurt. Baltimore is finalizing a trade for veteran QB Jacoby Brissett, which could upgrade the offense if he plays, and the total has already fallen from 48.5.
SportsLine's Mike Tierney leans Under 39.5, the same line as this bet. He points to Jacksonville allowing the second-fewest points per game (15.9) and the Ravens' banged-up third-string QB.

Covers (Joe Osborne) picks Strange anytime TD with Jaguars -9.5, not a receptions pick; says Strange has seen 7+ targets in 3 of his last 4 games, is JAX's #2 target, and Baltimore has given up six TDs to tight ends.

Undated blurb says Washington (12) and Thomas (8) took 20 of Lawrence's 29 targets in one game, leaving little for Strange, who still ran 25 routes on 31 dropbacks. Page shows 28 catches this season, about 4 per game across 7 games, right at the line.

Bucky Brooks says a short-handed Ravens team (Fagnano at QB) is in trouble and that JAX targets are spread over Washington, Meyers, Thomas and Strange. He describes a strong run game, which together with a big spread points to a lopsided game where JAX could pass less.
